jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Cuba has no AI-specific law. Its AI governance rests on a Strategy for the Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence led by the Ministry of Communications, approved in 2024 under the Digital Transformation Policy, whose official text could not be found, and on the general personal data protection law, Law 149 of 2022.
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026, but none of the Cuban government websites, including the Official Gazette, could be accessed. The data protection law is recorded from its official gazette address without its text being read, and the AI strategy and digital transformation policy are tracked as leads. Cuba is marked for a later retry.

instruments.official_title: Ley No. 149 "De Protección de Datos Personales"
instruments.english_title: Law No. 149 on Personal Data Protection
instruments.issuing_authority: National Assembly of People's Power (Asamblea Nacional del Poder Popular)
instruments.publisher_name: Ministry of Justice (Gaceta Oficial de la República de Cuba)
instruments.current_status: Adopted by the National Assembly on 14 May 2022 and published in the Gaceta Oficial, Edición Ordinaria No. 90 of 25 August 2022 (per the Ministry of Communications). Official text could not be opened from the research environment, so the entry-into-force date and any provisions on automated processing are unverified. The Ministry of Communications issued Resolution 58/2022 on the security of personal data in electronic form under it (see leads).
instruments.summary: Cuba's first comprehensive personal data protection law, setting the principles, procedures and definitions for processing personal data and giving effect to the constitutional right of individuals to access their personal data and to request its non-disclosure. It applies to public and private processing of personal data, which includes data used to train and run AI systems.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Only general law in force that governs personal-data processing by AI systems in Cuba; no AI-specific law exists.
metadata_gaps: Publication date taken from Ministry of Communications statement, not the gazette itself

leads.title: Estrategia para el Desarrollo y Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial
leads.english_title: Strategy for the Development and Use of Artificial Intelligence
leads.issuing_authority: Ministry of Communications (MINCOM); approved by the Council of Ministers
leads.note: Ministry of Communications statements say the strategy was approved in May 2024 as part of the Política para la Transformación Digital and presented publicly in January 2025; six axes (ethics and legal framework, human capital, applications and services, public administration, science and innovation, social communication). No official full text or gazette publication found; mincom.gob.cu and gacetaoficial.gob.cu unreachable from the research environment. Record once the official text is located (e.g. mincom.gob.cu/es/print/6983).
